**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blocking finding. This is the first review of this PR, and it is a SAFETY-tier review: the diff moves the stock simulation that makes the rest grid.

Review record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4217#issuecomment-7201522157

## What looks good

- `rest::stage_prior` keeps the order and the refusal texts of the old `prior_state`. I compared the two bodies line by line.
- `StagedPrior::simulate` reads no world and no per-thread engine switch. `Held` carries the engine that `first_held` selected at staging, so the job thread cuts on the same engine.
- `run_job` calls `settle_prior` first. Thus `pocket_reach`, the WCS yaw turn and each arm see the same `job.prior` as before.
- `run_job` and `zones_for_op` are the only readers of `job.prior`. The other callers of `collect_job` (`agie_profile`, `kept_rejudge`, `pocket_fit`) do not read it. They now skip a simulation that they never used.
- A stored error still surfaces at the arm that reads the grid. The unreachable state of `StagedPrior` is a named refusal, not a panic.
- `prior_state` keeps its signature. Its two direct callers in the tests stay green.
- The new module has its provenance line and reads the world (`crates/app/src/rest/staged.rs`). The decision file is present. No dependency, script or process file changes.
- The body has the `Changelog:` line and ends with `Refs #3035` (partial work).

## Results, trial-merged with upstream/main b7b940c8459d8e1ee33ee6e3c1ae165b0d51ca7e

All steps ran locally on m3 (macOS, 16 CPUs), in `.claude/worktrees/review-4217`. No GitHub runner was used. The merge was clean.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Pin `generate_staged::a_rest_reading_pocket_simulates_the_program_ahead_in_its_job_not_at_staging` | pass |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 181 steps, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` | 46 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored by their own markers |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| `operations::finish3d_waterlines_off_stamps_digest_skips_rings_notes_steep_flanks_and_leaves_rest` (calls `prior_state` directly) | pass |

Note on the quick gate: the host stopped the one full run at its time limit, at step 173 of 181. The logs of steps 1 to 173 each show `test result: ok`. I ran the last 8 steps in a second run: 8 steps, 0 failed. Each of the 181 steps ran one time and passed.

Extra suites run: none are owed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no importer code.

Heavy lanes: not run. This is a `P3` PR (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review").

## Mutations (run by the reviewer, then restored)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| A: remove `job.settle_prior()` from `run_job` | red: 16 tests in `generate_staged`, `rest_previous_ops`, `rest_adaptive_op`, `rest_across_setups`, `suppressed_rest` |
| B: run the simulation inside `rest::staged::stage` (the old timing) | red: the pin, `staging simulates nothing; left: 1, right: 0` |
| C: make `StagedPrior::without_grid` keep the grid | green in `carried_verify`, `rest_across_setups`, `carried_stock_entry`, `setup_carry_side`, `carried_fixtures_cache` (see note 1) |

After the restore, `git status` is clean and the pin is green again.

## Goldens

None moved. `git diff --stat upstream/main HEAD -- "*.nc" "*.cl" examples/catalog testdata` is empty. The body says the same.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

1. Mutation C shows that no test pins the `#319` rule "a distrusted carried grid gives no rest mask" for a rest operation. This gap is also on `main`: the old code had the same line with no pin. The new code is an equal translation (`keep_grid: false` sets `grid` to `None` after the simulation). Suggested follow-up: one test in `carried_verify` or `rest_across_setups`, `P7`.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs` has 609 lines and grows by 13. The file was above the 400-line limit before this PR. A split is a follow-up, `P7`.
3. `RegenerateAll` finishes its jobs in parallel. Each rest job now holds its stock grid and the moves ahead until its worker cuts them. The total work is the same, and the simulations now run in parallel. No action is necessary.
4. `rest::prior_simulations` is a public per-thread counter for the pin. It follows the pattern of `carried_body_computes`.

No UI file changes, so no screenshots are necessary.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
